items.summary: Update backend daily reset logic so users can log any number of questions per day (no fixed goal of 5), and apply streak/fine rules as: (a) if questions solved for the day is >= 1, increment current streak by 1 and apply no fine; (b) if questions solved for the day is 0, reset current streak to 0 and apply a flat fine of 20 rupees (always 20, not scaled). Persist the daily record with the day’s questionsSolved and the penaltyApplied amount.

Update backend APIs that set daily problem count to accept any non-negative count (Nat) without enforcing an upper limit of 5, and ensure the daily count update still triggers a reset first if the user is past the daily reset boundary (so the update applies to the new day).

Replace the frontend daily tracking UI that uses 5 checkboxes with an input that lets the user enter the number of questions solved today. If the input is left empty, treat it as 0 questions. Saving the value must call the existing updateTodayProblems mutation with the entered value (or 0 if blank).

Update the frontend reminder logic and copy to remove the “complete 5 problems” framing. The reminder should be based on maintaining the streak rule: show a reminder when today’s logged questions are 0 (i.e., they have not solved at least 1 question yet).
